sample.note: The service-weekday sample includes Tokyo cash-market holidays on 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-03; it is not 30 TSE trading sessions.

incident.interpretation: The workflow run did not exist until over four hours after the scheduled event; runner startup followed run creation by seconds. No acquisition completed and no Sheets close-row write/readback occurred.

finding.supported: Observed scheduled events and audit records show lateness before GitHub Actions run creation across the sampled dates.
finding.notEstablished: The evidence does not establish GitHub's internal cause. It does not support attributing the delay to provider outage, dependency setup, runner queue, or concurrency.
